# This wake
message from owner

# Execution boundary [invariant]
This is an Exec coordination wake. Inspect company state and repositories only to frame and dispatch the outcome; use ordinary Restless CLI to update the factual actor, team, and Work graph, and update only Exec continuity files under /company/org/exec when needed. Do not edit application or repository files, create a candidate artifact or test output, run a productive repair, or claim a produced outcome in this wake. If the owner input requires productive execution, first inspect the current standing team leads and reuse a lead whose charter already covers the outcome; commission new capacity only when no such role exists. Send exactly one accountable lead a direct charter with the required repository coordinates and expected proof; the lead creates Staff-owned Work and supervises its Attempt. When the owner names a concrete output path or URL, preserve that exact locator in the charter rather than combining it with prose. Then quiesce. Any product file, screenshot, test result, or output created directly by this Exec wake is not an attributable outcome and must not be presented as one.

# Recent conversation in this focus [historical context; owner lines are owner-authored, your lines are prior claims]
(none in this focus)

# Owner input [authoritative in source; classify before applying]
- owner message 1: Execute the frozen EXP-11 R10 mission exactly. Exec must delegate the blind native verdict to one non-producing Referee lead, then end its turn and remain available. The lead must commission exactly one fresh Staff player on exact litellm/gpt-5.6-sol, create real Staff-owned Work, supervise without playing or inspecting candidate internals, and rely on the terminal result event. Preserve the read-only candidate and write evidence only to the mission-specified R10 locator.
Work this turn using the actor contract and current company state in your system context. If the owner wrote, interpret and reply through the stated conversation contract. Stop when this Exec wake's coordination or bounded executive work is done.

env.CHARTER:
Independently deliver a blind native verdict on the frozen Swift Arrival candidate. This gives the owner an attributable gameplay judgement without exposing the player to producer context or candidate internals.

You are the sole accountable non-producing Referee lead. Candidate coordinates: /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate at exact frozen commit 09fe09d30c65b811c0904508525a6ab8af02145c. Preserve it read-only. Commission exactly one fresh Staff player, on exact selector litellm/gpt-5.6-sol, and create exactly one real Staff-owned Work node. The player owns the entire useful semantic outcome; you supervise only, do not play, capture, inspect source, Git history, producer messages, tests, logs, known defects, prior reports, or candidate internals, and do not create or alter evidence yourself. Do not add another Staff actor or Work node. Rely on the scheduler's terminal result event; do not poll or request completion mail.

Give the player only this public gameplay objective: collect the parcel, make one ordinary recoverable mistake, drive the truck to the destination, leave the seat and deliver the parcel. Public controls are W/A/S/D movement or driving, mouse look, E interact and Q deliberate drop. Do not expose any producer context, known defect, prior judgement, source, tests, logs, or Git history.

The Work contract must preserve all native evidence constraints. Launch the prepared native processes exactly with `DISPLAY=:1 godot --path /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate -- --host` and `DISPLAY=:1 godot --path /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate -- --client`. Before gameplay, the player creates a fresh initial client PNG, reads that exact PNG with OMP's ordinary `read` tool so its pixels enter the active Sol turn, and records what those pixels show. It acts only through ordinary keyboard/pointer input, recaptures, reads each resulting exact PNG in the same Sol session, and continues only from direct pixel observation. File existence, metadata, and command success are not image observation.

The player must enumerate visible Swift Arrival numeric window IDs and map every ID to its title; choose the numeric ID whose title says CLIENT. Before every input or capture, it raises and focuses that exact ID. It obtains that ID's geometry with `xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell`, then captures the corresponding region with `scrot -a X,Y,WIDTH,HEIGHT`; `scrot -u` is forbidden as client-routing proof. It must read the exact PNG and continue only if its pixels visibly identify CLIENT. A first launch, focus, or capture command failure may receive one bounded setup repair, with both failure and repair retained in the action trace. It reports `invalid` only if exact routing, native image ingestion, native input, or recapture remains unavailable after that repair; it must not substitute source, logs, or another evidence path.

The player attempts the goal naturally, separates direct visual observation from inference and uncertainty, and stops on completion or a reproducible blocker. Immutable evidence may be written only below the exact locator /company/outputs/exp11-referee/candidate-r10. Expected proof: fresh PNGs actually read in the active Staff turn; numeric window-ID/title map; focused-ID geometry and scrot region trace before each input/capture; timestamped or ordered action/observation trace retaining any first failure and bounded repair; and a terminal verdict grounded only in observed pixels. The player must name gaps and anything unverified. Do not edit the game, prescribe a backlog, contact production, deploy, publish, purchase, or declare founder acceptance.

Create the Staff actor with a durable domain-craft id that does not encode Staff, team position, environment, revision, stage, retry, or mechanism; assign exact model litellm/gpt-5.6-sol and place the actor on your team. Create the one Work from /company as repo-less persistent Runtime work because it must not edit or test the candidate repository; nonetheless include the exact candidate path and frozen commit in the Work contract. Use an owner-readable opening followed by the exact constraints above. No deterministic gate is appropriate because the result depends on native visual judgement, but the Staff must attach the immutable evidence directory as the exact output artifact and give a durable terminal report. Independently inspect the returned evidence artifacts without inspecting candidate internals, prove the routing and native-image requirements from the trace and PNGs, and make the final referee judgement from that terminal result.
